besluite.rede: 'n Bottel om slym in op te hoes' is a standard Afrikaans om-te construction with its preposition after the object; the proposal is longer and adds an obligation ('moes') without fixing a real fault.
'Sy kos het op die bord bly staan' is natural, vivid Afrikaans in the story's voice; the proposal is an equally natural alternative, so it is a lateral move.
'Nou al nagte lank wakker word met 'n nat hemp' reads naturally as waking night after night (like 'al weke lank'), and with 'word wakker' it does not suggest lying awake; the swap is lateral.
The plain coordinated clause is clear for a Grade 5 reader; 'wat almal TB noem' is no clearer and can briefly parse with 'wat' as subject, so it is not clearly better.
